Commentary.Commentary: India, on the other hand, had a day to forget with the ball. None of the bowlers except Bhuvneshwar Kumar were effective and he ended with respectable figures of 10-2-44-1. The spin duo of Ashwin and Jadeja went for plenty and they will be really disappointed. The Men in Blue will have to put their act together and put in a solid performance and a really good start is the need of the hour for them. Can the defending champions defend their title or will we have new winners this time around? Join us in a while for the chase.

Babar Azam also stepped up and made a useful contribution but it was the cameo from Mohammad Hafeez that made the difference. He made a quickfire 50 and along with Imad Wasim went ablaze in the end and helped them cross the 330-run mark. The Men in Green will be really happy with their batting performance as they all stepped up in the game which matters the most.

A terrific batting performance from Pakistan and they have posted a huge total on the board. They were determined from the very beginning and an efficient start from their openers laid the perfect platform for them. Azhar Ali and Fakhar Zaman stitched in a vital 128-run stand where the latter went to score his maiden ODI hundred after getting a reprieve just when he was on 3. The former was dismissed courtesy of a run out but nothing went India's way even after that.
Slow bouncer from Kumar. Wasim makes room, looks to ramp it over short third man but ends up slicing it over point. The batsmen can only manage to collect a run. PAKISTAN FINISH ON 338/4!
Banged in short, angling away, Wasim makes room, looks to hook it away but misses.
Another yorker, dug out in the cover region for a single.
SIX! Full and wide outside off, Hafeez reaches out and goes hard at it. Bunts it over mid off and the ball sails all the way for a maximum. That will help their total!
Wide yorker from Kumar. Hafeez advances down, tries to jam it out but manages to get a bottom edge back to the bowler.
Yorker, dug out on the leg side for a single.
Leg bye! Superb Free Hit delivery. Bumrah bowls a slow, in-dipper, deceives Wasim with the variation. The Pak all-rounder misses and the ball goes off the pads on the off side. A leg bye is taken.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball! Another one from Bumrah! Full outside off, driven to long off for a single. Bumrah has overstepped once again and it's his third no ball. He has got to be more disciplined at this level.
32nd ODI fifty for Mohammad Hafeez!
Fifty for Mohammad Hafeez! The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total. The Professor has scored at a brisk pace and he is leading his team towards a really good total.
Full toss, driven through mid on for a brace.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball! High full toss, Wasim mistimes it over covers for a single. Hang on, the umpire has his one hand stretched out. It's a no ball for height.
Full toss, driven crisply to Yuvraj at covers. A single is taken.

What happened there? The ball hit the stumps, but the bails don't fall. Bumrah bowls a perfect yorker, Hafeez fails to dig it out. The ball then deflects off the pads onto the stumps. The bail lobs a touch but then lands back in its place. Hafeez can't believe his luck and so can't Bumrah but for contrasting reasons.

Leg bye! Wasim shuffles a long way across, looking to scoop. Bumrah cleverly follows him with a yorker. Imad misses and gets rapped on the pads. The ball rolls beside the pitch and a leg bye is taken.
Slower delivery on a length outside off, Hafeez looks to flay it on the off side but misses. Superb over from Bhuvi. Just 5 from it!
Leg bye! Slower short delivery, Wasim looks to play a reverse-pull type shot. Misses and the ball lobs off his helmet towards the short fine leg region. A leg bye is taken.
50-run stand between Wasim and Hafeez!
Very full and very wide outside off, Hafeez looks to squeeze it out but gets an inside edge to the keeper. A quick single is taken.
Low full toss on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
Hafeez sets himself up for a pre-determined reverse scoop. Kumar, however, follows him and MH can only jam it out on the off side for a single.
Wasim dances down the track and digs it out to long on for a single.
Low full toss around off, driven to long off for a single.
Full outside off, Wasim tries to be cheeky. Goes for the reverse scoop but misses it completely. Hafeez is not happy with his partner and has a word with him after the ball.

FOUR! Slower length ball around middle and off, Imad clears his front leg and tonks it over mid off. Beats Pandya at long off and earns a boundary. Hardik had to cover only a few yards to his left but the ball was hit so hard that he couldn't get there.
Almost a yorker around off, dug out to short third man for a single.
Length delivery, angling away, Wasim goes hard at it but mistimes it through covers for a single.
Slower one to start off, Hafeez places it on the full through cover-point for a single.
Change of ends for Jasprit Bumrah!
Full toss on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, Hafeez slashes it over backward point. The man in the deep, cuts it off and keeps it down to two.
Very full on middle and off, almost a yorker, dig out through mid on for a single.
Full and angling in, driven through mid on for a single.
SIX! Hammered! Slower length delivery from Bhuvneshwar. Hafeez picks it early and pulls it handsomely over mid-wicket for a biggie. Moves to 38 off just 22 balls. 300 up for Pakistan.
Slower delivery wide outside off, Hafeez tries to glide it on the off side but misses.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar replaces Bumrah!
Almost a yorker, dug out on the off side for a quick single.
Wasim once again dances down and drills it uppishly towards long on for a single.
SIX! That's hit hard! Flatter delivery around off, this time Wasim dances down the track and bunts it down the track over long  for a flat maximum. 14 runs off the over already.
Full outside off, eased down to long off for a single.

SIX! Just over! Jadhav tosses it up, Hafeez dances down the track, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over long on. Pandya in the deep, jumps full stretch but can't get his fingers to it. The ball sails over and lands over the ropes. Hafeez is playing a gem of an innings here.
Sliding away from the southpaw, Wasim mistimes his slog to long on for a single.

On a length around leg, Imad tucks it in the mid-wicket region and slips as he takes off for a quick single. Bumrah gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses but Wasim does well to recover and reach back in.
Back of a length slower delivery, MH waits for it and glides it to third man for a single.
Length delivery, angling away, Imad punches it past the diving point fielder for a single.
On a length and angling in, defended with soft hands in the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Bumrah slants it into the pads, Hafeez flicks it through forward square leg. Beats the deep mid-wicket fielder and picks up another boundary. He is ticking along nicely!
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to backward point.
India's death bowling specialist is back on.
Off spinner on off, milked down to long off for a single.
Slower through the air outside off, Wasim makes room and slashes it through covers for a single.
Jadhav bowls a round-arm delivery around off, Hafeez dabs it towards short third man for a single.
Imad Wasim strides out to the middle.

OUT! Azam misses out on his half century. Tries to take on the part-timer Jadhav. Dances down the track, goes for the big lofted shot but ends up miscuing it to Yuvraj at long off. The veteran doesn't make any mistake and Azam has to walk back. Jadhav's golden arm once again does the trick. India are pulling things back at the right moment.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Hafeez makes room, Jadhav follows him. The Professor can only punch it back to the bowler.
Kedar Jadhav is back on.
On a length and angling in, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Bhuvi goes for the yorker, ends up bowling a low full toss, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Kumar goes for the bouncer once again. However, it's too short this time and a wide is signaled for height.
FOUR! Hafeez is taking the attack to the opposition. Advances down the track and pulls the back of a length delivery over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Banged in short, Hafeez sees that and gets out of harm's way.
Length delivery outside off, punched to long off for a single.
Azam kneels down and paddle sweeps down the leg side for a single.
Shortish outside off, cut through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Bad, bad ball this, from Jadeja! Slants it down the leg side, Hafeez kneels down and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary. The left-arm orthodox is proving to be expensive again.
Full around off, pushed to cover.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Hafeez continues from where he left against England. Dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes it down the track over mid off for a boundary. Off the mark in style.
Ravindra Jadeja is back into the attack.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle.
Another good length delivery around off, Azam works it towards the fielder at mid-wicket. A sensational over from Bhuvneshwar. Only a run and a wicket from it.
Length delivery outside off, Azam drives it towards the fielder at mid off.
Mohammad Hafeez walks out to bat.

OUT! Malik holes out! Short delivery outside off, Malik plays the forehand smash. Does not middle it well and the ball goes towards the deep cover region. Jadhav gets under it and takes a simple catch. Bhuvneshwar has struck at a really crucial time as Malik could have been dangerous in the latter stages.
Good length delivery outside off, Malik throws his bat at it but cannot make contact.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar sees Shoaib Malik making room and he pulls out at the last moment.
Length delivery outside off, Malik dabs it towards the fielder at point.
Length delivery around off, Azam guides it towards third man for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is brought back for a bowl.
A bit short around off, Malik cuts but straight to the fielder at point.
Azam stays in his crease and drives it towards long off for a single.
Wide! A replica of the last ball.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Azam lets it through.
Worked through the square leg for a single.
Azam stays in his crease and punches it towards long on for a single.
Quicker one around off, Malik cuts it late. Rohit from short third man dives to his right to make a good stop. A single is taken.
A loose delivery into the pads, Azam pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Kedar Jadhav is introduced into the attack.
Short delivery into the batsman, Malik goes for the hook at first but sways away at the last moment.
Angling into the batsman, Azam wrists it through the square leg region. Runs the first one hard and slips while turning for the second run. So only a run taken in the process.
Good length delivery outside off, Azam punches it through covers for a couple.
Wide! Sprayed way down the leg side, Azam fails to clip it through. This is the tenth wide of the innings.
Fuller around off, Azam drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Angling into the hips, Azam stays in his crease and flicks it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Babar makes the most of it! Short delivery outside off, Azam stays in his crease and cuts it over the backward point region for a boundary.
Azam comes down the track and eases it down to long off for a single.
Driven down to long off for a single.
SIX! Malik gets into the act! Tossed up outside off, Malik comes down the track, reaches to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the extra cover region for half a dozen.
Angling into the stumps, Azam punches it through covers for a single.
Quicker one around off, Malik cuts it through the point region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Azam punches it towards covers for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on.
It's a short ball and a dot ball this time. Malik pulls it but cannot beat the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length delivery outside off, Azam punches it through the cover-point region for a single.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Short delivery outside off, Azam stays in his crease and pulls it with grit. Over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fuller around off, Azam digs it out towards the fielder at mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Azam punches it through the cover region for a couple.
Short delivery into the batsman, Babar goes to play the pull shot but fails to make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Azam punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Good length around off, Azam punches it straight towards the fielder at point.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full toss into the pads, Babar is obliged as he just helps it through the vacant square leg region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Malik dabs it towards third man for a single.
Fuller around off, Malik drives it back to the bowler.
Azam punches it through covers for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja was handed the ball at first but Virat Kohli had a change of mind at the last moment.  He brings Jasprit Bumrah back into the attack.
Fuller around off, Malik drives it straight to the fielder at cover. An excellent over from Pandya where he gives away just two runs and takes a wicket.
Back of a length delivery around off, Azam drags it towards fine leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Babar Azam goes to drive it on the up. Misses it completely and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Good length delivery outside off, Malik guides it towards third man for a single.
Length delivery around off, Shoaib Malik defends it towards the fielder at point.
Shoaib Malik is the new man in.

OUT! Jadeja does not miss those! Length delivery outside off, Zaman takes his front leg out of the way and goes to play a wild slog. Mistimes it and the ball balloons over the backward point region. Jadeja there, traces back and takes a really fine catch to send back the opener. A terrific innings from the southpaw comes to an end and India will want a couple of quick wickets to get back in the game.
Tossed up around off and spinning in, Azam comes down the track and tries to block it away. Gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Zaman cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Azam paddles it towards short fine leg for a single.
Zaman comes down the track and he throws his bat at it. Gets it off the toe end towards long off for a single.
SIX! Brilliant! Floated around leg, Fakhar takes out his front leg and sends that deep into the deep mid-wicket stands for a maximum.
Another short ball, Babar Azam pulls it through the mid-wicket region. Shikhar Dhawan chases it down through the deep square leg region and saves the boundary. The batsmen run a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Fakhar punches it through the cover-point region for a single.
Another short delivery into the batsman, Zaman pulls but cannot get it past the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Short delivery into the batsman, Fakhar goes for the pull. Gets it off the splice through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Length delivery outside off, Zaman cuts it straight towards the fielder at backward point.
Short delivery outside off, Fakhar Zaman sways away from the line of the ball.

Drinks break! Another good phase of play for Pakistan apart from the wicket. They have been playing beautifully and Fakhar Zaman has scored his maiden ODI century. They will want to post a really big total now. India on the other hand will want to trigger a collapse because chasing a big total under pressure is never going to be easy.
Azam punches it back to the bowler. Ashwin dives to his right and makes a fine stop to save runs for his team.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Quicker one outside off, Zaman gets an inside edge and the ball goes to the keeper. Hits Dhoni low on the pads.
Tossed around off, Zaman comes down the track and lofts it over the cover region. Kedar Jadhav fumbles in the deep which allows them to take two runs easily.
Zaman drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Maiden ODI century for Fakhar Zaman!

FOUR! Ton for Fakhar and it has come against their arch rivals India! Fuller outside off, Fakhar Zaman sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary. He has been sensational throughout and he is playing a terrific knock when it matters the most, in the high-pressure finals.
Leg bye! On a length around leg, Zaman looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball lobs off the thigh pad on the leg side. A leg bye is taken. Back-to-back tight overs for India.
Back of a length outside off, guided to third man for a single. 50-run stand between Azam and Zaman.
On a length around off, tapped to mid on.
Pitched on a length outside off, Babar feels for it but gets beaten.
Length delivery outside off, chopped to backward point.
Back of a length delivery around leg, pulled on the bounce to fine leg. A single is taken.
Spinning into the batsman, played with the turn to forward square leg.
Azam goes back and punches to cover.
Off spinner on off, clipped to short mid-wicket again.
Spinning in from around off, turned to mid-wicket.
Zaman eases it down the long on for a single.
Short delivery, fired at 100 kph. Zaman looks to punch it on the off side but gets an outside edge to short third man.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short delivery, Azam rides the bounce and pulls it through backward square leg for a brace.
Outside off, Azam looks to glide it on the off side but misses.
Length delivery, tapped in front of covers for a single.
FOUR! Pandya goes short again, Zaman looks to pull it but doesn't seem in control of the shot. Gets a glove on it and the ball flies over the keeper's head for a boundary. He moves into his nineties!
Shortish delivery outside off, punched through point for a single.
Hardik Pandya is called back for a bowl.

FOUR! Edgy! Shorter delivery outside off, Zaman looks to punch it with an angled bat. Gets an outside edge which runs fine down the off side. Bumrah from short third man, chases after it, gets his hands to it but fails to keep it in. 17 runs from the over. The spinners have been hammered in the past two overs!
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Slanting into the pads, turned to mid-wicket.

Some shot, that! Full outside off, driven crisply through covers. Bhuvneshwar from long off, hares to his right and makes a diving stop near the fence. Saves a run for his team. Such efforts will lift India. The timing however was exceptional on that one.

SIX! This is superb counter-attacking cricket from Zaman. He is in his groove now. He dances down the track, goes through with his slog. Seems to have mistimed it but the ball sails over the long on fence for half a dozen. He is on fire!
Wide! Another one sliding down the leg side. Zaman once again leaves it alone and gets a wide.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Zaman leaves it alone. A wide is signaled.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Safe shot to play with mid off and extra cover in place and no one in the deep. Uses his feet, gets down the track and goes inside out over covers for a boundary. 16 runs off the over. Massive one for Pakistan!
Punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Served outside off, pushed to cover.
Calm thing to do. Punches the ball off the back foot to long on for a single.
FOUR! Short outside off, Zaman makes room and cuts it hard past point for a boundary. He is so strong in that region.

SIX! What a shot! This is good intent from Zaman. He doesn't want India to put pressure on them. Dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and clobbers it over long on for a maximum. This is good cricket from the opener.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Zaman eases it down to long on for a single.
Zaman down the track and heaves it to wide long on for a couple.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut towards short third man, where Bumrah makes a solid diving stop to deny a run.
Straying on the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Zaman goes back and punches it through mid on for a single.
Zaman works it in the backward square leg region for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Spinning into the pads, Zaman works it behind square on the leg side. Wants a single but Azam isn't interested. It was an easy single though.
Turned with the spin on the leg side.
Full outside off, reverse swept to point.
Spinning in from around off, drives it towards mid on.
Babar Azam walks out at no. 3!

OUT! Big mix-up! And, this time the luck goes India's away! Ali dabs it in the mid-wicket region and takes off for a single. His partner, however, stays unmoved at the bowler's end and both the batsmen end up at one end. Bumrah runs to his left and throws the ball to his keeper, who whips the bails off. Azhar Ali has to depart. It was an easy single. 128-run stand comes to an end. Can this open the floodgates for India?

NOT OUT! He is fine! Sliding into the batsman, defended with soft hands in the mid-wicket region. Yuvraj there, gets to the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Zaman puts in a good dive to come in but the umpire still goes upstairs to confirm. The replays show that Fakhar was well in.
Yuvraj has scored a direct hit at the bowler's end. The umpire has gone upstairs to check if Zaman's dive has saved him. Seems fine!
Flatter delivery, Zaman makes room and cuts it straight to point.
Another straighter one, punched down to long on for a single.
Once again slides it into the pads, eased down to long on for a single.
Drifts it into the pads, played across the line to mid-wicket.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on.
Tossed up around off, pushed to cover.
Full around off, driven to covers.
Spinning away from outside off, glided past short third man. This time Jadhav cuts it off in the deep. A brace is taken.

FOUR! Another short delivery from Jadeja and this time it's put away. Ali the batsman, who makes room and cuts it hard through backward point. Beats Jadhav in the deep and picks up another boundary. Pakistan are cruising through at the moment!
Shortish delivery around off, spinning in, Zaman makes room and cuts it through point. Yuvraj dives to his left and makes a half stop. A single is taken.
Flatter delivery on middle, defended neatly.
An effort ball from Pandya. Bangs it short outside off, Ali looks to ramp it over the keeper's head but misses.
Back of a length delivery, angling away. Sits up nicely to Zaman, who middles his pull over square leg. Goes on the bounce to Yuvraj, who doesn't make any mistake this time. A single is taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, pulled over square leg for a single.
Fuller on the pads, Zaman flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Short outside off, Ali rides the bounce and plays a controlled pull to long leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the front foot to mid on.
3rd ODI fifty for Fakhar Zaman!

FOUR! Three fifties in a row for Fakhar Zaman! Tossed up outside off, Zaman cuts it through point. Yuvraj misfields there and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. The southpaw has been in tremendous form and he has continued with it. Will look to convert it into a century tonight.
12th ODI fifty for Azhar Ali!

Second consecutive ODI fifty against India! Fuller into the batsman, Ali clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single. He has played a good knock till now and he will look to make it big today.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! He finally gets a boundary through his favourite region! Spinning in from around off, Zaman cuts it through the cover region for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Zaman tries to cut it hard but cannot beat the fielder at point.
Ali stays in his crease and punches it through covers for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Zaman lets it through.
Short delivery into the batsman, Ali pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.

A rare misfield from Jadeja! Good length delivery outside off, Zaman dabs it towards backward point where Jadeja misfields. The batsmen run a single and Jadeja scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batsman was already in.
Good length delivery outside off, Zaman tries to guide it towards third man but fails to make contact.
Fuller around middle and leg, Ali clips it towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet! Zaman comes down the track and slogs it over the wide mid on region for a boundary. 100 up for Pakistan.
Ali punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller outside off, Zaman sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Zaman stays deep in his crease and nudges it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Around middle and leg, Zaman clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Ali drives it through point for a single.

Drinks have been taken. Pakistan are currently on top of their game. They have been batting really well and have scored runs at a quick pace, also the luck seems to be on their side. India, on the other hand, will need some wickets to get back in the game. An interesting phase of cricket awaits.

Ali punches it towards the mid on fielder. Finds the fielder standing at the edge of the circle which allows them to take the single easily. Bumrah collects it quickly and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Short delivery into the body, Zaman pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.

In the air.....safe! Short delivery into the batsman, Azhar Ali charges down the wicket and goes for a big one. Gets it off the splice of the bat and the ball balloons over the cover fielder. Rohit Sharma from mid off and Virat Kohli from cover try to reach it but cannot. Ali lands himself with a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Azhar Ali stays in his crease and punches it straight to covers.
Fuller around leg, Ali clips it on the leg side. Yuvraj Singh at mid-wicket dives to his right to make a fine stop.
Back of a length around off, Azhar Ali stays in his crease and defends it well.
Zaman stays in his crease and defends it well.
Ali stays in his crease and punches it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up around leg, Zaman comes down the track and whips it through the wide mid on region for a single.
Drifting around middle and leg, Ali drives it down the ground. Jadeja cannot stop it and the batsmen run a single.
Fuller around off, driven back to the bowler.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja is into the attack now.
FOUR! Good shot! Short and wide outside off, Ali slashes it off the outer half over the backward point region for a boundary.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Length around off, Ali gets an inside edge towards the short fine leg region for a single.
Short delivery into the body, Zaman pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
That might hurt! Back of a length delivery into the body, Zaman gets hit on his body.

Leg bye! Good length delivery and angling in, Ali tries to drive it on the up. Misses it completely and he gets rapped on his back thigh pad. The ball goes past the keeper towards third man for a leg bye. A huge appeal is denied. Hardik wants a review but Dhoni indictaes height to Kohli. The skipper takes his keeper's words and doesn't opt for the review. Replays show that the impact was umpire's call. Later the snicko shows that it had hit the front pad first.
Hardik Pandya is introduced into the attack.
A bit short around off, Ali nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fuller into the pads, Zaman fails to clip it through and gets rapped on the pads.
Fuller around middle and leg, Zaman goes for the reverse sweep and he miscues it towards the fielder at short third man.
Ali stays in his crease and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Drifting around leg, Fakhar Zaman tries to back away, Ashwin follows him. Gets an inside edge through square leg for a single.

Zaman stays in his crease and defends it with soft hands on the leg side for a quick single. Pandya is quick to reach the ball but misses his shy at the striker's end. It wouldn't have mattered if that had hit as the batsmen are equally quick between the wickets.
Fuller around off, Ali flicks it towards mid on and scampers across for a single. Yuvraj Singh has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Zaman clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Another stifled appeal turned down! Fuller around middle and leg, Azhar Ali gets an inside edge onto his pads. Gets it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller around off, Ali mistimes his drive towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Wide! Sprayed way down the leg side, Ali tries to clip but he misses. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Back of a length delivery around off, Ali punches it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Zaman is trying to match his partner! Tossed up around middle and leg, Fakhar comes down the track and heaves it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fuller into the stumps, Zaman blocks it away.
Ali flicks it through the deep square leg region for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket
Fakhar clips it through the mid-wicket region. Calls for the second but his partner sends him back so he has to settle for the single.
Sprayed into the pads, Zaman is unable to clip it away and is rapped on the pads.
Fuller delivery around middle and leg, Ali misses his clip and gets rapped on the pads. A stifled appeal is denied as it was going down leg.

Huge shout for LBW! Good length delivery and angling into the batsman, Ali shuffles across and tries to clip it on the leg side. Misses it completely and gets rapped high on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. Good call as the replays show it was way too high.
Zaman punches it through the cover region for a single.

FOUR! Beautiful! Fuller delivery around off, Zaman drives it dead straight along the ground. Ali is down on the ground trying to reach back at the crease to save himself but sees the ball race away to the fence.

Run out chance missed! Angling into the hips, Azhar Ali tucks it away in the mid-wicket region and scampers for a single. Rohit picks it up and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Had he hit, Ali was gone by a mile.
Length delivery and angling away, Fakhar Zaman guides it towards third man for a single.
Jasprit Bumrah is back for a bowl.
Powerplay 2 has been taken. Now a maximum of four fielder are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.

Sliding into the southpaw, Fakhar plays away from his body, gets an inside edge to short fine leg for a single. End of a good Powerplay for Pakistan. They are scoring at a good rate and most importantly haven't lost a wicket.
Full on middle, flicked through wide mid on for a single.
Served around leg, Zaman advances leg side of the ball, goes for a hard slog but gets it off the inside half to short fine leg. A single is taken.
Ashwin drags his length a touch back, Ali punches it down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Swept away! Full in the line of the stumps, Ali kneels down and sweeps it hard through the gap between short fine leg and backward square leg for a boundary. Azhar has been on a counter-attacking role, here! He doesn't want Ashwin to settle down.
Spinning into the pads, turned on the leg side.
Pitched around leg, Zaman makes slight room but fails to clip it away. Gets rapped on the pads once again. Second maiden this, for Bhuvneshwar.
On the pads, Zaman looks to play it across the line but misses. The ball rolls on the off side.
Length delivery on middle, defended down the track.
Another short delivery from Bhuvneshwar. Zaman once again tries to pull it but the ball gets big on him and goes over his bat.
On a length and angling away, pushed to mid off.
Banged in short, angling away, Zaman looks to pull but misses.
Spinning in from around off, punched down the track. Ashwin dives to his right and makes a good stop.

SIX! This is good intent from Ali! Not letting Ashwin settle. The Indian offie tosses it up outside off, Azhar dances down the track and lofts it over long off. The timing is so good on it that the ball sails over the fence for the first maximum of the day.
Flatter delivery outside off, Ali prods forward and pushes it to point.
Once again Ashwin slants it into the southpaw, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Ashwin drifts it down the leg side. Zaman leaves it and a wide is signalled.
A slip for the southpaw.
Tossed up around off, spinning in, turned through forward square leg for a single.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side. Ali shimmies a touch and looks to flick but misses. A wide is signaled.
Off spinner around off, defended neatly.
Ravichandran Ashwin is into the attack now.
Full around off, tapped back to the bowler.
Pitched outside off, driven on the up to mid off.
Ali taps it wide of Kohli at mid on and takes a quick single. Virat has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Outside off, Ali checks his drive to mid off.
Almost carried! Short outside off, pulled straight down the track but falls short of Kumar in his followthrough.
On the pads, worked to short fine leg for a single.
Length delivery, Ali defends it solidly. Another expensive over from Bumrah!
FOUR! Ali with another boundary. Slower one, angling in, Ali flicks it wristily through square leg. Yuvraj in the deep, runs to his left, dives but fails to stop it. Second boundary off the over.
Full around off, driven to covers.
Wide! Again Bumrah bowls it down the leg side, Ali misses to flick it and a wide is signalled.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azhar goes for a wild pull but misses it completely. He doesn't need to play such shots as Zaman from the other end will keep doing that.
On a length outside off, punched to mid off.
FOUR! Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali has a go at it but gets a thick outside edge. Flies over the slip cordon and to the fence behind.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Zaman not getting off to his usual flier. Dances down the track, goes through with a big heave on the leg side. Gets it off the inner half through square leg for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Four Leg Byes! Banged in short, Zaman goes for the pull but is late into the shot. The ball hits him on the helmet and goes through the gap between Dhoni and Sharma at wide slip for a boundary.
On middle and leg, pushed to mid on.
Length delivery, punched to cover-point.
Angling into the batsman, defended to mid-wicket. 12 runs off the over but surely not a bad over from Bumrah. He could have had a wicket there.
Wide! Full but down the leg side again. Ali fails to tickle it and a wide is signaled.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! First boundary from Azhar. Short outside off, Ali plays a flat-batted shot past the bowler. Beats the mid on fielder and earns himself a boundary.
Zaman taps it beside the pitch on the off side and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Edgy! On a length and angling away, Zaman goes hard at it. Gets an inside edge and the ball runs to the fine leg fence.
Superb delivery, this! Zaman tries to make room, Bumrah follows him with a yorker which sneaks through the batsman's legs.
Free Hit coming up...

OUT... Hang on... It's a no ball. Length delivery, slanting away, Zaman looks to poke at it but gets an outside edge and Dhoni behind the stumps celebrates. India starts celebrating but the umpire wants to check for a no ball. Bumrah's nightmare comes true as the replays confirm it's a no ball. Zaman survives. This can be a big blow to India as the Pakistani opener can take the game to the opposition.
Wide! Bumrah once again gets his line wrong. Bowls it down the leg side. Zaman looks to flick it but misses. A wide is signaled.
Pitched in the line of the stumps, tapped back to the bowler.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Fuller on the stumps, flicked to right of mid-wicket. Pandya makes a diving stop there but fails to prevent another quick single.
Angling into the pads, Ali looks to work it but gets an inside edge. The ball brushes the pads and runs down the leg side. A single is taken.

Run out chance! A touch ahead of length on middle. Zaman taps it in front of covers and takes off for a quick single. Jadhav there, runs to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Zaman was a goner.
Streaky runs! On a length outside off. Ali hangs his bat, gets an outside edge past the second slip for a run. First runs off Bhuvi's bowling.
Length delivery on middle and leg, defended on the leg side.
Full on leg, dug out to mid-wicket.
Length delivery around off, Ali shimmies just a touch and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Pitched on middle, angling away a touch. Zaman looks to push it away from his body, gets an inside edge and the ball runs to fine leg for a single. Fakhar is off the mark.
Wide! Full and swinging down leg, Zaman misses his flick and a wide is signaled. First runs on board.
Length delivery on middle and leg, defended on the leg side.
Full toss on the pads, Zaman looks to whip it away but gets beaten by pace. Is rapped on the pads and Bumrah appeals mutely. However, it's turned down.
Jasprit Bumrah to start with the second new ball. Just a slip in place for him.
Pitched outside off, Ali leaves it alone. Good start by Bhuvneshwar. It's a maiden.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Full outswinger outside off, driven crisply but straight to Pandya at short cover.
Full outside off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Angling into the batsman, Ali shimmies a touch and looks to work across but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full outside off with a hint of away swing, Ali makes a watchful leave.
The final is about to get underway. Fakhar Zaman and Azhar Ali to open for Pakistan. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start the first new ball. He has a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
The players observed a minute of silence in the memory of the victims of the Grenfell Tower victims. They are now standing in attention for their respective national anthems.

PITCH REPORT - Nasser Hussain says that there is a little bit of grass on the wicket but it is dead grass. Feels that there will be nice carry on the deck. Mentions that it is a fresh pitch which has not been used in the tournament. Informs that the outfield is full of lush green grass but the boundaries are long. Ends by saying that it is a good surface for batting.

Sarfraz Ahmed says that he would have bowled first as well but the toss is not in their hands. Mentions that it's a good wicket for batting. Adds that when they came here, they were ranked eighth and had nothing to lose and today also they are going to play with the same attitude. Informs that Mohammad Amir is fit and will replace Rumman Raees.

Virat Kohli says that he will bowl first. Mentions that it is a hard wicket which should stay true throughout. Informs that they are a side which likes chasing so they will look to chase any total down. Adds that the guys are looking forward to put their best performances in the final game of the tournament. Reckons that they take every opponent seriously and they believe in their abilities. Ends by saying that they are unchanged.
TOSS - INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD!

The Men In Green after their first loss have pulled their act together and haven't lost a game since. No one expected them to get till here but they have proved all their critics wrong. The Men In Blue too have suffered one loss this tournament against Sri Lanka. Apart from that, they have displayed a superb all-round performance in the rest of their games. They are the favourites to defend the trophy but Pakistan are known to create major upsets. The all-important toss is coming up!

Hello and a warm welcome to the one of the most anticipated matches of the year. It's the finals of ICC Champions Trophy, 2017 between India and Pakistan at The Oval. One of the fiercest rivalries and the cricket fans all over the globe would have their eyes glued to this. Both these teams started this tournament against each other in which India dominated their neighbours.
